metadata.title: Websites Experience Surge in TikTok Traffic
metadata.description: Social media referrals as a percentage of overall traffic to sampled websites (in %)*
metadata.main_insight: Facebook referrals as a percentage of overall website traffic have significantly decreased from the first half of 2016 to the second half of 2017, while other platforms like Pinterest, Instagram and Twitter remained relatively stable.

datafacts.annotation: The Instagram has the smallest proportion in 1H '16.
datafacts.reason: The Ratio of Instagram in 1H '16 accounts for 0.0002754062241806665, smaller than all other Social Platforms, of the total of Ratio of all Social Platforms.

datafacts.annotation: The Ratio of Facebook and Instagram show a negative correlation.
datafacts.reason: The Pearson correlation coefficient of the Ratio between Facebook and Instagram is {r:.2f}, indicating a strong negative relationship.

datafacts.annotation: The Instagram has the smallest proportion in 2H '16.
datafacts.reason: The Ratio of Instagram in 2H '16 accounts for 0.0026455026455026454, smaller than all other Social Platforms, of the total of Ratio of all Social Platforms.

datafacts.annotation: The Twitter shows a sudden jump in Ratio from 2H '17 to 1H '16.
datafacts.reason: The Ratio for Twitter increases from 0.7 at 2H '17 to 0.9 at 1H '16, indicating a sharp change.

datafacts.annotation: The total value of Facebook has the smallest proportion.
datafacts.reason: The total value of Ratio of Facebook accounts for 0.00819732663761908, smaller than all other Social Platforms, of the total of Ratio of all Social Platforms.

titles.sub_title: Percentage of Facebook referrals to overall website traffic has significantly decreased.
